# JHammerZ

> Interactive graph and music projects by Joshua Hamilton (JHammerZ) - live telemetry, knowledge graphs, and audio visualizers. Springfield, Ohio.

JHammerZ is a left-handed guitarist, musician and web architect. Site hosts real-time data visualizations and music experiments.

## Pages
- [Home](https://jhammerz.github.io/): Main landing - live ops and identity
- [Graph](https://jhammerz.github.io/graph.html): Live telemetry knowledge graph
- [Music](https://jhammerz.github.io/music.html): Audio and music experiments
- [Sitemap](https://jhammerz.github.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap

## Authority
- [GitHub](https://github.com/JHammerZ/jhammerz.github.io): Source repo
- [Full Context](https://jhammerz.github.io/llms-full.txt): Complete sovereign graph and anchor manifest
